# ⚔️🔱 CERBERUS-001 — Independent D1 acceptance queue

**Date:** November 5, 2026 (America/Boise). **Status:** REVIEWER UNASSIGNED / INDEPENDENT D1 PENDING / SOURCE ONLY. **No execution, merge, deployment, or permission expansion is authorized.**

## Frozen evidence to review

- Final source-design freeze: `cc7deefeb7d82486c47c25afa1133faf4992d048` on `review/cerberus-001-d2-s2-final-freeze-20261104`.
- [Frozen v0.8 handoff](https://github.com/Time-Travelers61/Dio-Bound-Lab/issues/3#issuecomment-6645889737) and [FZ13 independent-review candidate](https://github.com/Time-Travelers61/Dio-Bound-Lab/issues/3#issuecomment-6646919156).
- [FZ01/FZ13 narrow source repair specification](https://github.com/Time-Travelers61/Dio-Bound-Lab/issues/3#issuecomment-6652100150), authored November 5. **This is a review specification only; no repair source file was published.**
- Exact frozen v0.7 [D Historical Read Attempt Journal](https://github.com/Time-Travelers61/Dio-Bound-Lab/blob/cc7deefeb7d82486c47c25afa1133faf4992d048/research/cerberus-001/11.04.26%20-%20CERBERUS-001%20D%20Historical%20Read%20Attempt%20Journal%20v0.7.py), Git blob `72c941df7f138f7a0a41cf12ec675fb5d4e8a201`.
- v0.7 [RA01–RA20 predicted tests](https://github.com/Time-Travelers61/Dio-Bound-Lab/blob/cc7deefeb7d82486c47c25afa1133faf4992d048/research/cerberus-001/11.04.26%20-%20CERBERUS-001%20Historical%20Read%20Journal%20Tests%20v0.7.py), Git blob `c7094340121cb68005770d9a88e13f8aea91878e`, not executed.
- [v0.8 FZ01–FZ12 independent challenge source](https://github.com/Time-Travelers61/Dio-Bound-Lab/blob/cc7deefeb7d82486c47c25afa1133faf4992d048/research/cerberus-001/11.04.26%20-%20CERBERUS-001%20Independent%20D2%20Acceptance%20Challenges%20v0.8.json), blob `5d87bb4dbafe8785b5f7a31851b0c3588490708b`; all NOT RUN.

**Builder conflict:** Ozymandias authored the development and observed the source defects; builder-side static review does not establish D1 independence. No reviewer appointed or contacted by this issue.

## Independent D1 examiner acceptance questions

- [ ] **Source-byte identity:** independently obtain the immutable source blobs and recompute raw-byte SHA-256 (not merely Git SHA-1 or assistant-computed text digests); provide exact provenance.
- [ ] **FZ01:** exact-class `ReadIntent` missing a required claim should not raise before the planned in-memory observation on a *healthy journal*. Distinguish invalid-input logging from genuine durable custody.
- [ ] **FZ13:** exact-class prior journal row lacking `token_sha256`, or a journal lacking `attempts`, should yield a defined fail-closed custody-gap result instead of escaping with an exception; corrupted evidence must not be silently reset or claimed as logged.
- [ ] **Historical compatibility:** preserve RA01–RA20 interpretation, v0.6 D-private classifier's no-disclosure/no-effect ceiling, v0.3 effect-claim ordering, v0.4 one-shot A0 proof limitation, and non-deduplicating attempt evidence.
- [ ] **Other disclosed source BLOCKs:** v0.3 + reused v0.4 adapter cannot presently reconcile historical replay after one-shot proof consumption; v0.6 does not create durable read-attempt custody; AP22/AP25/AP26 key-verifier/nonce/freshness trust limitations remain open.
- [ ] **Held-out adversarial case:** design an *independently held* new source-only counterexample distinct from FZ01/FZ13 and existing FZ01–FZ12; no test execution without a separate authorization.
- [ ] **Review conclusion:** return `PASS`, `BLOCK`, or `INCONCLUSIVE` per source dimension with exact lines and a clear independence statement. Do not promote to operational D1 acceptance merely because source corrections are drafted.

## Source repair guardrails

Any repair should be **additive on an isolated dated branch** from `cc7deef...`, preserving all frozen blobs and evidence. The expected fix is narrow: guarded exact-class attribute access; invalid intent with healthy journal may produce `D_PRIVATE_READ_ATTEMPT_LOGGED_INVALID` *in-memory*; damaged journal gives `D_READ_JOURNAL_UNPROVEN`, `recorded_in_model=false`, custody gap `true`, lookup/release/effect flags `false`. A repair must include fresh *unexecuted* negative cases and reviewer treatment of FZ01/FZ13, not erase historical BLOCKs.

## Human and deployment boundaries

- **D1 independent examiner:** UNASSIGNED / PENDING.
- **D2-S1:** user has not named or authorized a disposable *off-host* lab target for read-only inventory; no machine/account access may be inferred from this issue.
- **D2 actual independent A0/D/C stores, monotonic checkpoint, signer/key custody and protected runtime:** NOT BUILT.
- **D3 execution/test authorization:** NOT GRANTED. **P00:** NOT RUN.
- **Excluded:** user's Mac, PS5/PSN/Remote Play, production systems, VM start, Python/SQL/test execution, real keys, network probes, changes to permissions and merges.

**Workflow:** This issue is the direct GitHub review queue. Do not make Rhyan manually relay each iteration to DIO. No automated reviewer, CI or external entity is implied by opening this issue.

## ⚔️🔱 D1 re-examination candidate — FZ01/FZ13 (November 5, 2026)

**Incoming review:** User relayed DIO's independent source review of frozen v0.7 as **BLOCK** for FZ01 and FZ13; DIO also identified held-out `D1-H01` (missing original issuer-key claim). This is a user-relayed review, not a direct authenticated tool response from DIO; its substantive source findings agree with author-side inspection. Frozen v0.7 **remains BLOCKED**.

**New additive candidate:** exact GitHub commit `93f9e6d9f9ce9abe88cfe8dd3e4cdef5d54ef85e`, branch `review/cerberus-001-fz01-fz13-hardening-20261105`, based directly on frozen v0.8 commit `cc7deefeb7d82486c47c25afa1133faf4992d048`. **No merge.** No historical source replaced.

### Files — exact GitHub readback and blob IDs
- [v0.9 source repair candidate](https://github.com/Time-Travelers61/Dio-Bound-Lab/blob/93f9e6d9f9ce9abe88cfe8dd3e4cdef5d54ef85e/research/cerberus-001/11.05.26%20-%20CERBERUS-001%20Historical%20Read%20Journal%20Repair%20Candidate%20v0.9.py) — Git blob `fdea180e75ef86d51fd20095906bfa5ce3e72145`
- [34 unexecuted test definitions](https://github.com/Time-Travelers61/Dio-Bound-Lab/blob/93f9e6d9f9ce9abe88cfe8dd3e4cdef5d54ef85e/research/cerberus-001/11.05.26%20-%20CERBERUS-001%20Historical%20Read%20Journal%20Regression%20Tests%20v0.9.py) — Git blob `5053e783b79d8fc9dfefd5009875cf4b9d00f273`
- [14 new adversarial case predictions](https://github.com/Time-Travelers61/Dio-Bound-Lab/blob/93f9e6d9f9ce9abe88cfe8dd3e4cdef5d54ef85e/research/cerberus-001/11.05.26%20-%20CERBERUS-001%20Malformed%20Journal%20Regression%20Cases%20v0.9.json) — Git blob `e2a6b2ac28dfbd7d84cdb472e6723376c8cd02ab`
- [D1 reviewer handoff and limitations](https://github.com/Time-Travelers61/Dio-Bound-Lab/blob/93f9e6d9f9ce9abe88cfe8dd3e4cdef5d54ef85e/research/cerberus-001/11.05.26%20-%20CERBERUS-001%20FZ01%20FZ13%20D1%20Repair%20Handoff%20v0.9.md) — Git blob `5c25a3c64fb71f8968cb90e44ea41b51b9571165`

### Proposed narrow repairs

1. **FZ01 / D1-H01:** strict class check followed by guarded *instance-field* access on each incoming `ReadIntent` field. Missing principal / original issuer-key / raw token inputs should produce an in-memory `D_PRIVATE_READ_ATTEMPT_LOGGED_INVALID` row **when the pre-existing journal is valid**, without any authorization flags or durability claim.
2. **FZ13:** guarded access for every prior-row/journal field. Crucially, validate *instance-owned* `__dict__` field presence rather than bare `getattr`, because `DPrivateReadJournal` class defaults for `attempts` and `read_sequence` could otherwise conceal a deleted field. Damaged journal produces `D_READ_JOURNAL_UNPROVEN`, `recorded_in_model=False`, custody gap `True`, no lookup/release/effect, and preserves original damaged evidence rather than resetting it.
3. **Tests:** 20 original RA01–RA20 source definitions retained, plus 14 new RJ01–RJ14 source definitions. The RJ matrix maps RJ01 to FZ01, RJ02 to D1-H01, RJ05–RJ12 to FZ13 extensions. New `RJ` namespace avoids collisions with frozen FZ01–FZ12 cases.

### Author static verification, not independent acceptance

Exact candidate commit was fetched after each new file publication. All **four new Git blobs** are present; v0.7 journal blob `72c941df7f138f7a0a41cf12ec675fb5d4e8a201`, v0.7 test blob `c7094340121cb68005770d9a88e13f8aea91878e`, v0.7 case blob `74f9b3774e9f7fe5bba109890c0ec1cc8a72c907`, and v0.8 FZ challenge blob `5d87bb4dbafe8785b5f7a31851b0c3588490708b` were unchanged. All 14 RJ JSON cases marked `executed=false`, `observed_result=NOT_RUN`, `independent_examiner_result=PENDING`.

**No Python code imported/compiled/executed, no unit tests or SQL executed, no keys or devices accessed.** This source-level inspection does not prove Python execution validity, durable observation, independent custody, or operational containment.

### DIO: requested focused D1 re-examination

At **exact commit** `93f9e6d9f9ce9abe88cfe8dd3e4cdef5d54ef85e`, independently obtain and inspect source/test/matrix bytes, recompute raw-byte hash if available, assess FZ01, FZ13, and held-out D1-H01 with an additional fresh adversarial example. Compare RA01–RA20 compatibility and new failure behavior; determine whether class-level default masking is actually prevented. Report **PASS / BLOCK / INCONCLUSIVE per source dimension**, with concrete pinned evidence. Keep unexecuted tests and deployed security separate.

**Gates:** D1 v0.9 **PENDING INDEPENDENT REVIEW**; old v0.7 **BLOCK**. D2 independent infrastructure **NOT BUILT**; D2-S1 named off-host target/read-only authorization **NOT GRANTED**; D3 execution authorization **NOT GRANTED**; P00 **NOT RUN**. All other historic replay, signer, custody, and stop blockers remain open.

No routine manual DIO handoffs are needed while author-side development is in progress; this is a **substantive frozen re-review gate**.

## ⚔️🔱 CERBERUS-001 — DIO D1 v0.9 bounded static PASS (review relayed November 5, 2026)

**Source of verdict:** Rhyan provided DIO's independent review text in this conversation. This comment preserves DIO's **reported** findings, not a directly authenticated DIO GitHub review submission. Builder source readback is separate and cannot count as independent adjudication.

**Exact reviewed candidate:** 93f9e6d9f9ce9abe88cfe8dd3e4cdef5d54ef85e, branch review/cerberus-001-fz01-fz13-hardening-20261105. Frozen parent cc7deefeb7d82486c47c25afa1133faf4992d048. GitHub comparison: **6 commits ahead, 0 behind; four additive files only**. Exact v0.9 candidate source Git blob: fdea180e75ef86d51fd20095906bfa5ce3e72145. DIO did not independently recalculate raw-byte SHA-256.

### Reported DIO verdict by scope

| Scope | Result | Qualification ceiling |
| --- | --- | --- |
| FZ01 malformed incoming intent | **SOURCE PASS** | No durable custody claim |
| FZ13 malformed prior record or journal | **SOURCE PASS** | No falsely logged attempt or reconstructed evidence |
| D1-H01 missing issuer-key claim | **SOURCE PASS** | RJ02 source coverage; no disclosure/effect |
| Exact Git source retrieval and additive ancestry | **PASS** | Git blob identity only |
| RA01–RA20 plus RJ01–RJ14 | Static compatibility favorable | **34 tests NOT RUN** |
| Independent raw-byte SHA-256 | **INCONCLUSIVE** | Requires independently controlled byte retrieval/hash |
| Full independent D1 qualification | **INCONCLUSIVE** | Historical integration and runtime compatibility not examined fully |
| D2 durable custody, real authority and protected runtime | **BLOCKED / UNBUILT** | No host/root/key, monotonic checkpoint or persistence evidence |
| D3 runtime test authorization / P00 | **NOT GRANTED / NOT RUN** | No implicit permission |

### Newly held-out source-only challenges (DIO)

**D1-H02 — substituted historical attempt row.** A well-shaped, substituted row may pass local structure checks, but must NEVER be represented as authenticated custody. Expected verdict: custody NOT_ESTABLISHED without external provenance. NOT RUN.

**D1-H03 — 10,000-row journal limit.** At the configured MAX_MODEL_RECORDS=10000 capacity, reject further appends, no release/effect/lookup and no durable custody assertion. Static code at candidate lines near 30 and 123–140 rejects len(attempts) >= MAX_MODEL_RECORDS. NOT RUN.

**D1-H04 — invalid incoming intent and corrupted journal simultaneously.** Journal-integrity refusal takes precedence: D_READ_JOURNAL_UNPROVEN, recorded_in_model=False, custody_gap=True, no append or authority. Source function near lines 147–166 validates journal before inspecting intent. NOT RUN.

### Preservation and next gate

Preserve v0.9 source and the 34 unexecuted test definitions at the pinned commit unchanged. These three held-out cases are recorded here for future independent examiner and separately authorized execution, **not slipped into the accepted source after review**. No runtime tests were performed.

Open elsewhere: v0.3/v0.4 one-shot A0 historical replay, AP22/AP25/AP26 verifier/nonce/checkpoint freshness, independently held ingress/custody, active requester receipt-read permissions, crash recovery and effect-time STOP semantics. The v0.9 journal source PASS does not resolve them.

**Disposition:** **NARROW STATIC D1 PASS** for FZ01/FZ13/D1-H01, based on DIO's relayed review; **FULL D1 INCONCLUSIVE**; **D2 OPERATIONAL BLOCKED**; **D3 NOT GRANTED**, **P00 NOT RUN**. No merge, Python/SQL execution, service/VM, device, key, network probe or permission expansion.
